description: Every Microsoft Defender Antivirus preference (Get-MpPreference) shown and edited by the Defender & Security Control Center. mp is the property (shown only when this platform reports it). kind: protection (on/off; changes only toward on), hardening (optional extra protection that is off by default; changes only toward on), level (graded; values marked refused turn the protection off and are never set), option (any listed value, no protective direction), parser (Network Inspection; only ever turned on, without revert), info (shown only). type: bool, enum (values), uint (min/max), time (HH:mm, stored as minutes after midnight), text, list. edit: set (Invoke-IgwtDefenderSettingChange with a snapshot), parser (Set-IgwtDefenderParsersOn), policy (only through the ADMX policy named in policy, with -PolicySet), readonly (never changed; note says why). policy is the ADMX policy that also sets it; when a policy sets it, local changes are refused because the policy wins. doc picks the Microsoft source from docs (default mp).

coveredElsewhere.area: ASR Center (controlled folder access allowed apps)

settings.name: Real-time protection
settings.hint: Scans files when they are opened, run or written.

settings.name: Behavior monitoring
settings.hint: Watches process behavior for malware patterns that files alone do not show.

settings.name: Scan downloads and attachments (IOAV)
settings.hint: Scans files that browsers and mail clients download.

settings.name: Script scanning
settings.hint: Scans PowerShell, VBScript and JavaScript through AMSI.

settings.name: Scan network files
settings.hint: Scans files opened from network shares.

settings.name: Scan archives
settings.hint: Scans inside .zip, .cab and other archives.

settings.name: Scan e-mail files
settings.hint: Scans mailbox files such as .pst during full scans (off by default).

settings.name: Scan removable drives (full scans)
settings.hint: Includes USB drives in full scans; real-time protection scans them on access anyway.

settings.name: Real-time scan direction
settings.hint: Which file activity real-time protection scans; both directions is the default and the only value iG Windows Tuner sets.

settings.name: Protection during Windows setup (OOBE)
settings.hint: Turns on real-time protection and security intelligence updates during the out-of-box experience.

settings.name: Cloud-delivered protection (MAPS)
settings.hint: Sends the file metadata cloud protection needs; Basic now behaves like Advanced.

settings.name: Block at First Sight
settings.hint: Holds new files until the cloud returns a verdict (needs cloud protection and sample submission).

settings.name: Cloud block level
settings.hint: How aggressively the cloud blocks unknown files; High+ and Zero tolerance can block legitimate unsigned tools.

settings.name: Extended cloud check
settings.hint: Extra seconds (up to 50) a file is held for the cloud verdict.

values.label: Never send
values.why: Block at First Sight stops working without sample submission.

settings.name: Sample submission
settings.hint: Which suspicious files Defender may send to Microsoft for analysis.

settings.name: Catch-up quick scan
settings.hint: Runs a missed scheduled quick scan at the next opportunity.

settings.name: Catch-up full scan
settings.hint: Runs a missed scheduled full scan at the next opportunity.

settings.name: Update before scheduled scans
settings.hint: Gets the latest security intelligence before each scheduled scan.

settings.name: Scan CPU load limit
settings.hint: Average CPU a scan may use (5-100, default 50); 0 removes the limit.

settings.name: Low CPU priority for scheduled scans
settings.hint: Runs scheduled scans at low priority so games and work stay smooth.

settings.name: Scheduled scans only when idle
settings.hint: Starts scheduled scans only when the PC is not in use.

settings.name: No CPU limit for idle scheduled scans
settings.hint: On (default): scheduled scans on an idle PC ignore the CPU load limit.

settings.name: CPU limit for scheduled scans only
settings.hint: On (default): the CPU limit applies to scheduled scans only; off: also to custom scans.

settings.name: Full scans on battery power
settings.hint: Lets scheduled full scans run while a laptop is on battery.

settings.name: Scan mapped network drives (full scans)
settings.hint: Includes mapped network drives in full scans (off by default).

settings.name: Restore point handling off
settings.hint: Microsoft: whether Defender skips restore points; the policy creates a daily restore point before cleaning when off.

settings.name: Cache maintenance off
settings.hint: Off (default): the idle maintenance task keeps Defender's cache up to date.

settings.name: Scheduled scan type
settings.hint: Scan type of the scheduled scan (default quick).

settings.name: Scheduled scan day
settings.hint: Day of the scheduled scan: every day, one weekday or never.

settings.name: Scheduled scan time
settings.hint: Local time of the scheduled scan (default 02:00).

settings.name: Scheduled scan offset
settings.hint: Scheduled scan time as minutes after midnight (default 120).

settings.name: Daily quick scan time
settings.hint: Local time of the daily quick scan.

settings.name: Remediation scan day
settings.hint: Day of the full scan that completes a remediation.

settings.name: Remediation scan time
settings.hint: Local time of the remediation full scan (default 02:00).

settings.name: Randomize scheduled task times
settings.hint: Starts scheduled scans and updates within 30 minutes of the set time to spread the load (default on).

settings.name: Scheduler randomization window
settings.hint: Window in hours for randomized scheduled tasks (default 4).

settings.name: Scan history retention
settings.hint: Days scan history is kept (default 15).

values.label: Scan contextual exclusions in quick scans

settings.name: Scan exclusions during quick scans
settings.hint: Quick scans also check files excluded from real-time protection with contextual exclusions.

settings.name: Security intelligence update interval
settings.hint: 0 uses the default schedule; 1-24 checks for updates every N hours.

mustMatch.why: Keep Microsoft Update or the Microsoft Malware Protection Center in the list, or the PC can stop getting updates.

settings.name: Update source order
settings.hint: Where security intelligence updates come from, in order, separated by |.

settings.name: Scheduled update day
settings.hint: Day of the scheduled update check (default never; the update interval still applies).

settings.name: Scheduled update time
settings.hint: Local time of the scheduled update check (default 15 minutes before the scheduled scan).

settings.name: Catch-up update after
settings.hint: Days without an update before Defender requires a catch-up update (default 1).

settings.name: Update grace period
settings.hint: If an update succeeds within this period, Defender drops service-initiated updates.

settings.name: First update grace period
settings.hint: Grace period for the first update; overrides Update before scheduled scans.

settings.name: No startup update without an engine
settings.hint: Whether Defender skips updates at startup when no antimalware engine is present.

settings.name: Update over metered connections
settings.hint: Lets updates download over metered connections (data charges may apply).

settings.name: Security intelligence update channel
settings.hint: When daily security intelligence updates arrive during the gradual rollout.

settings.name: Engine update channel
settings.hint: When monthly engine updates arrive during the gradual rollout.

settings.name: Platform update channel
settings.hint: When monthly platform updates arrive during the gradual rollout.

settings.name: Binary update deployment channel
settings.hint: When monthly platform and engine binaries arrive (safe deployment channel).

settings.name: Skip the gradual rollout
settings.hint: Offers updates only after the gradual release cycle finishes (for datacenter PCs).

settings.name: Signature blob update interval
settings.note: Microsoft documents only 'Specifies the signature update interval' without a unit; shown only.
settings.hint: Interval of the dynamic signature (blob) updates.

settings.name: Shared security intelligence location (VDI)
settings.hint: UNC share with pre-downloaded updates for virtual desktops.

settings.name: Shared location updates at scheduled time only
settings.hint: VDI: take updates from the shared location only at the scheduled update time.

settings.name: File share update sources
settings.hint: UNC shares used when FileShares is in the update source order.

settings.name: File share sources for signature blobs
settings.note: An enterprise distribution setting without a Group Policy; shown only.
settings.hint: UNC shares for dynamic signature updates.

settings.name: Proxy server
settings.hint: Proxy Defender uses for cloud protection and updates.

settings.name: Proxy auto-config (PAC) URL
settings.hint: PAC file Defender uses to find its proxy.

settings.name: Proxy bypass list
settings.hint: Destinations Defender reaches without the proxy.

settings.name: Use only the proxy
settings.hint: Forces Defender to connect only through the configured proxy.

settings.name: Default action: low threats
settings.hint: 0 uses Defender's recommended action; Allow and No action are refused in the policy too.

settings.name: Default action: moderate threats
settings.hint: 0 uses Defender's recommended action.

settings.name: Default action: high threats
settings.hint: 0 uses Defender's recommended action.

settings.name: Default action: severe threats
settings.hint: 0 uses Defender's recommended action.

settings.name: Default action: unknown threats
settings.note: There is no Group Policy for it and Defender's recommended action (0) cannot be set back with Set-MpPreference; shown only.
settings.hint: Action for threats without a severity level.

settings.name: Per-threat overrides: threat IDs
settings.hint: Threat IDs with their own default action.

settings.name: Per-threat overrides: actions
settings.hint: The action for each overridden threat ID; Allow is refused.

settings.name: Quarantine retention
settings.hint: Days before quarantined items are deleted (default 90; 0 keeps them).

values.label: Off
values.why: Turns potentially unwanted app blocking off.

settings.name: Potentially unwanted apps (Defender)
settings.hint: Blocks adware, bundlers and coin miners. Edge PUA blocking is under Web & phishing.

settings.name: Network protection
settings.hint: Blocks connections to known-bad domains and IP addresses in every app.

settings.name: Convert warn verdicts to block
settings.hint: Blocks instead of warning for indicators set to warn.

settings.name: Network protection reputation engine
settings.hint: Which reputation engine network protection uses (default standard).

settings.name: Asynchronous inspection
settings.hint: Lets checked network flows switch to asynchronous inspection for performance.

settings.name: UDP receive offload (network protection)
settings.hint: Lets network protection use UDP receive offload (default off). Can lower its overhead on game traffic; measure.

settings.name: UDP segmentation offload (network protection)
settings.hint: Lets network protection use UDP segmentation offload (default off); measure.

settings.name: Apply network scanning setting to IOAV
settings.note: Not documented by Microsoft; shown only.
settings.hint: Undocumented interaction between network file scanning and download scanning.

settings.name: Inbound connection filtering
settings.hint: Inspects inbound traffic with Network Inspection.

settings.name: DNS sinkhole
settings.hint: Answers lookups of known-malicious domains with a sinkhole address.

settings.name: Datagram (UDP) processing
settings.hint: Lets network protection inspect UDP traffic.

settings.name: DNS parser
settings.hint: Inspects DNS over UDP.

settings.name: DNS over TCP parser
settings.hint: Inspects DNS over TCP.

settings.name: HTTP parser
settings.hint: Inspects plain HTTP.

settings.name: TLS parser
settings.hint: Inspects TLS handshakes (the server name, not the encrypted content).

settings.name: SSH parser
settings.hint: Inspects SSH.

settings.name: RDP parser
settings.hint: Inspects Remote Desktop traffic.

settings.name: FTP parser
settings.hint: Inspects FTP.

settings.name: SMTP parser
settings.hint: Inspects SMTP mail traffic.

settings.name: QUIC parser
settings.hint: Inspects QUIC (HTTP/3).

settings.name: Brute-force protection
settings.hint: Detects and blocks attempts to force sign-ins and sessions (for example RDP password guessing).

settings.name: Brute-force protection aggressiveness
settings.hint: How confident Defender must be before it blocks an IP address.

settings.name: Brute-force protection block time
settings.hint: Longest time an IP address stays blocked; 0 lets Defender decide (Microsoft: 15-minute increments).

settings.name: Brute-force protection blocks local addresses
settings.hint: Extends brute-force blocking to local network addresses (default off).

settings.name: Brute-force protection: skip learning period
settings.hint: Starts blocking immediately instead of after the 2-week learning period.

settings.name: Brute-force protection exclusions
settings.note: An exclusion list: shown only. iG Windows Tuner never adds exclusions.
settings.hint: Addresses brute-force protection never blocks.

settings.name: Remote encryption protection
settings.hint: Detects and blocks attempts to replace local files with encrypted copies from another device (remote ransomware).

settings.name: Remote encryption protection aggressiveness
settings.hint: How confident Defender must be before it blocks an IP address.

settings.name: Remote encryption protection block time
settings.hint: Longest time an IP address stays blocked; 0 lets Defender decide (Microsoft: 15-minute increments).

settings.name: Remote encryption protection exclusions
settings.note: An exclusion list: shown only. iG Windows Tuner never adds exclusions.
settings.hint: Addresses remote encryption protection never blocks.

settings.name: AI agent protection
settings.hint: Scans prompts sent to managed AI coding agents for malware and abuse before the agent runs them.

settings.name: AI agent network inspection
settings.hint: Inspects network traffic of AI agent processes and blocks traffic that matches a detection.

settings.name: Dev Drive performance mode
settings.hint: On: files on Dev Drives are scanned asynchronously. Off: synchronously (slower, scanned before use).

settings.name: File hash computation
settings.hint: Computes a hash of every scanned file (used by file indicators); costs some CPU.

settings.name: Remove scanning thread pool cap
settings.note: Not documented by Microsoft; shown only.
settings.hint: Undocumented scanning thread pool setting.

settings.name: Additional action detection timeout
settings.hint: Minutes before a detection that needs additional action is shown as cleared (default 10080).

settings.name: Critical failure detection timeout
settings.hint: Minutes before a critically failed detection changes state (default 10080).

settings.name: Non-critical failure detection timeout
settings.hint: Minutes before a non-critically failed detection is shown as cleared (default 1440).

settings.name: Service health report interval
settings.hint: How often the service health events 1150 and 1151 are written (default 60).

settings.name: Report dropped dynamic signatures
settings.hint: Writes an event when a dynamic signature is dropped (default off).

settings.name: Network protection performance telemetry off
settings.hint: Stops sending network protection performance telemetry to Microsoft.

settings.name: Defender core service telemetry off
settings.hint: Stops the core service's OneDsCollector telemetry; Microsoft notes it slows its response to false positives.

settings.name: Core service ECS integration off
settings.hint: Stops fast fixes through the Experimentation and Configuration Service; fixes still arrive with updates.

settings.name: Headless UI mode
settings.hint: Hides the Defender interface from users (headless UI mode).

settings.name: Privacy mode (legacy)
settings.note: A legacy setting with no effect on current platforms (Microsoft); shown only.
settings.hint: Hid threat history from non-administrators on old platforms.

settings.name: Server role automatic exclusions off
settings.hint: Windows Server only: turns off the automatic exclusions for server roles.

settings.name: Network protection on Windows Server
settings.hint: Windows Server only: allows network protection to be set to block or audit.

settings.name: Network protection on Windows before 1709
settings.hint: Older Windows only: allows network protection to be set to block or audit.

settings.name: UDP inspection on Windows Server
settings.hint: Windows Server only: controls inspection of UDP connections.

settings.name: Tamper Protection override
settings.note: Tamper Protection is changed only in Windows Security or by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; iG Windows Tuner never changes it.
settings.hint: Shows whether a local Tamper Protection override is reported.

settings.name: Hide exclusions from local users
settings.hint: Standard users cannot list Defender exclusions (attackers look for them).

settings.name: Intel Threat Detection Technology
settings.hint: Uses Intel TDT (CPU telemetry) to detect ransomware and coin miners on supported Intel CPUs. Microsoft marks the policy deprecated.

settings.name: Package inspection
settings.note: Not documented by Microsoft; shown only.
settings.hint: Undocumented package inspection mode.

settings.name: Trust label protection
settings.note: Not documented by Microsoft; shown only.
settings.hint: Undocumented trust label protection status.
